description_html:
München (präferiert) oder Remote

Baue mit uns die Weiterbildungssuche der Zukunft.

Unsere Plattform GenauMeinKurs soll Menschen dabei helfen, schneller und einfacher die Weiterbildung zu finden, die wirklich zu ihnen passt. Dafür verbinden wir eine moderne Kurssuche mit AI-basierter Nutzerqualifizierung, organischem Wachstum, Performance Marketing und Daten.

Dafür suchen wir keinen klassischen Marketing Manager. Wir suchen einen technisch starken Growth Marketer, der Reichweite und qualifizierte Leads aufbaut und wissen will, was nach dem Klick passiert. Der Muster in Daten erkennt, AI praktisch einsetzt und gemeinsam mit uns unseren B2C-Funnel kontinuierlich besser macht.

Wir entwickeln zudem intelligente Software- und Datenlösungen für den Markt der beruflichen Weiterbildung. Mit unseren Produkten unterstützen wir bereits über 100 Bildungsträger dabei, ihre Bildungsangebote effizient zu verwalten, mehr Menschen zu erreichen und erfolgreicher zu wachsen.

Mit rund 20 Kolleginnen und Kollegen bieten wir dir viel Gestaltungsspielraum und kurze Entscheidungswege. Unser Gründer- und Führungsteam bringt langjährige Erfahrung im Aufbau und in der Skalierung digitaler Plattformen mit – bei uns verbindest du Startup-Geschwindigkeit mit der Möglichkeit, von einem erfahrenen, sympathischen (:)) und outcome-orientierten Team zu lernen.

Aufgaben

Drei Schwerpunkte stehen zunächst im Fokus:

  • AI-basierte Lead-Qualifizierung: Wir möchten die Nutzer bestmöglich dabei begleiten, die für die individuellen Ziele passende Weiterbildung beim passenden Anbieter zu finden. Wir glauben hierbei fest, dass AI bei dem Matching der genau passenden Weiterbildung eine zentrale Rolle spielt. Nach einer Anfrage qualifizieren wir Nutzer zudem persönlich und AI-gestützt weiter. Du analysierst Nutzerinteraktionen, erkennst Muster und verbesserst gemeinsam mit Product und Tech Prompts, Qualifizierungslogiken und User Journeys, um Lead-Qualität, Funnel und Marketing kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
  • SEO, Content & GEO: Mit tausenden Kursen von hunderten Bildungsanbietern haben wir ein starkes Fundament für organisches Wachstum. Du identifizierst Potenziale (Content & Tech), entwickelst skalierbare Content- und Landingpage-Ansätze und setzt AI überall dort ein, wo sie Qualität und Geschwindigkeit verbessert. Dazu gehört insbesondere auch GEO (Generative Engine Optimization).
  • Performance Marketing: Unsere Paid-Aktivitäten steuern wir gemeinsam mit einer spezialisierten Agentur. Du übernimmst mit die Verantwortung auf unserer Seite, setzt Ziele und KPIs, bringst unsere Daten zur Lead-Qualität in die Kampagnensteuerung ein und monitorst Kampagnen, Keywords und Landingpages und Conversions. Du musst nicht täglich selbst im Ads-Konto sitzen – aber gut genug verstehen, was dort passiert, um die richtigen Entscheidungen zu treffen und perspektivisch weitere Paid-Kanäle zu erschließen.

Mit der Zeit kommen weitere Themen dazu: Conversion-Optimierung, Lifecycle Management in HubSpot, Paid Social sowie AI-basierte Automatisierung und agentische Workflows.

Qualifikation

Uns ist weniger wichtig, wie viele Jahre Berufserfahrung du hast oder ob du bereits jede einzelne Aufgabe gemacht hast. Entscheidend ist, wie du denkst, lernst und Dinge vorantreibst und ein maximalen Fokus auf die Interessen unserer User setzt.

Wenn eine Kampagne oder Maßnahme viele Leads liefert, willst du wissen, ob es auch die richtigen sind. Wenn die Conversion sinkt, schaust du auf den gesamten Funnel. Wenn wir im Index sinken interessiert es Dich warum. Und wenn du etwas noch nicht kannst, findest du heraus, wie es funktioniert.

  • Du bringst praktische Erfahrung in Growth, Performance oder Digital Marketing mit und hast in mindestens einem unserer Kernbereiche – SEO, SEA/Paid, CRO oder Marketing Automation – bereits hands-on gearbeitet.
  • LLMs sind für Dich fester Bestandteil Deines Arbeitsalltags. Prompts, APIs und Automatisierung findest du spannend – auch wenn Du selbst kein Developer bist.
  • Du denkst analytisch und hast ein gutes Verständnis für Funnels, Tracking und Performance-KPIs und hast keine Probleme damit, eng mit Product & Tech zusammenzuarbeiten.
  • Du bist technisch neugierig und arbeitest selbstverständlich mit AI-Tools.
  • Du lernst schnell, arbeitest eigenständig und übernimmst Verantwortung für Ergebnisse.

Ein Plus, kein Muss: Erfahrung mit Claude (Code), Chat GPT, Gemini, Google Ads, HubSpot, GA4, Search Console, Meta Ads, Looker Studio, SQL, n8n/Make oder vergleichbaren Tools.

Benefits

  • 🚀 Viel Gestaltungsspielraum und Verantwortung vom ersten Tag an.
  • 🤖 AI als echter Bestandteil von Marketing, Qualifizierung und Customer Journey.
  • 📊 Daten vom ersten Klick bis zur tatsächlichen Conversion.
  • 🧪 Freiheit, neue Ansätze schnell zu testen und erfolgreiche Ideen zu skalieren.
  • 💡 Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit einem erfahrenen Gründer- und Führungsteam, Product, Tech, Sales und Customer Success.
  • 🏡 Flexible Arbeitszeiten, 30 Tage Urlaub sowie die Wahl zwischen unserem Büro in München-Giesing und Remote Work.
  • 📈 Die Möglichkeit, Growth Marketing bei uns maßgeblich mit aufzubauen.
  • 🛠️ Ein modernes Toolset mit Google Workspace, Slack, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, HubSpot, Make und weiteren Tools.

So läuft der Prozess

  • Kennenlernen: 30 Minuten mit unserer Recruiterin – über dich, die Rolle, gegenseitige Erwartungen und die wichtigsten Rahmenbedingungen.
  • Fachgespräch: Wir gehen gemeinsam durch einen echten Fall aus unserem Growth-Funnel und diskutieren, wie du an das Thema herangehen würdest. Keine Case Study, keine Hausaufgabe über Nacht.
  • Team kennenlernen: Im Büro oder per Video lernst du weitere Kolleginnen und Kollegen kennen. Wenn es für beide Seiten passt, folgen zeitnah Entscheidung und Angebot.

Wir halten das Tempo hoch: Du bekommst schnell Feedback und wir schließen den gesamten Prozess innerhalb weniger Wochen ab.

Klingt spannend?

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf oder dein LinkedIn-Profil.

Noch spannender als perfekte Stationen finden wir, was du selbst aufgebaut, optimiert oder herausgefunden hast – egal ob SEO-Projekt, Kampagne, Funnel, Automation oder AI-Experiment.

title: Consultant Professional Services (w/m/d)

description_html:
Die ic-solution GmbH ist Teil der one:ic Gruppe, einem der führenden Beratungs- und Lösungsanbieter für digitales Informationsmanagement im deutschsprachigen Raum. Wir unterstützen unsere Kunden dabei, dokumentenbasierte Prozesse effizient zu gestalten, Informationen intelligent zu verarbeiten und moderne Technologien gewinnbringend einzusetzen.

Unser Fokus liegt auf der Digitalisierung von Eingangsprozessen (Input Management), der Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen sowie der Implementierung innovativer Lösungen rund um Enterprise Content Management (ECM), Workflow-Automatisierung und Künstliche Intelligenz.

Unser Team arbeitet flexibel aus Leipzig und dem Homeoffice. Was uns verbindet: Neugier, Gestaltungswille und die Freude daran, mit modernen Technologien echten Mehrwert für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden zu schaffen.

Aufgaben

Zur Verstärkung unseres Professional-Services-Teams suchen wir dich als Consultant (m/w/d), der bzw. die bestehende Kundenprojekte fachlich und konzeptionell leitet, Kunden und Projektmitarbeitende sicher führt und unsere Kundenbeziehungen langfristig und umfassend betreut. Du behältst auch bei komplexen Anforderungen den Überblick, denkst analytisch und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams!

Deine Aufgaben – vielseitig, anspruchsvoll, zukunftsorientiert

  • Fachliche und konzeptionelle Leitung von Kundenprojekten im Bereich Input- und Prozessmanagement
  • Führung von Kunden in den bestehenden Projekten
  • Umsetzung und Anforderungsmanagement von Projekten im Rahmen der Leistungen des Professional Services
  • Langfristige und umfassende Betreuung von Kundenprojekten – von der Konzeption bis in den laufenden Betrieb
  • Konzipieren und Realisieren komplexer technischer Lösungen im Bereich der Dokumenten- und Informationserfassung auf Basis unterschiedlicher Plattformen und Standardprodukte
  • Design, Konfiguration und Rollout passgenauer Lösungen in enger Abstimmung mit dem Kunden
  • Verständliche Vermittlung komplexer Prozesse und technischer Zusammenhänge gegenüber dem Kunden
  • Enge Abstimmung mit interner Entwicklung, Produktmanagement und Partnern sowie klare Formulierung fachlicher Anforderungen

Qualifikation

Dein Profil – das bringst du idealerweise mit

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung (z. B. Fachinformatiker:in), Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, BWL oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Erfahrung in der Prozessanalyse, -modellierung oder IT-nahen Beratung
  • Gute Kenntnisse, insbesondere in den Bereichen Softwarekonfiguration, Schnittstellen und Datenbanken (z. B. MS SQL, PostgreSQL)
  • Kenntnisse in Input-Management- oder BPM-Lösungen von Vorteil
  • Themen wie N8N, BPMN und LLM sind dir nicht fremd
  • Interesse an Künstlicher Intelligenz, Automatisierung und neuen Technologien
  • Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke sowie Kunden- und Lösungsorientierung
  • Analytisches Denkvermögen und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise
  • Fähigkeit, auch in stressigen Situationen einen kühlen Kopf zu behalten
  • Reisebereitschaft sowie Freude am Umgang mit Menschen
  • Mut, eigene Ideen einzubringen, sich um Dinge zu kümmern und aktiv mitzugestalten

Benefits

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und hybrides Arbeiten (Büro und/oder Homeoffice)
  • Attraktive, leistungsgerechte Vergütung und moderne technische Ausstattung
  • Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten – fachlich wie persönlich
  • Einblicke in innovative KI- und Automatisierungsprojekte mit der Möglichkeit daran selbst mitzuwirken
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge und betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung
  • Zusätzliche Freizeittage, Firmenevents und ein kollegiales Team mit echter Startup-Mentalität

Neugierig geworden?

Dann werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft intelligenter Prozesse.
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung – unkompliziert und ohne lange Umwege.

Gerne stehen wir dir auch für Fragen zur Verfügung.
Mehr Infos findest du auf unserer Website oder im persönlichen Gespräch.

title: Business Analyst KI-Prozessautomatisierung (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at KnowWay GmbH
description_html:
Wir bei KnowWay entwickeln KI-Agenten für kritische Infrastruktur – Energie, Telekommunikation und öffentlicher Sektor. Überall dort, wo Compliance, Nachvollziehbarkeit und Datensouveränität keine Kompromisse zulassen, automatisieren wir Geschäftsprozesse mit KI.

Dabei begleiten wir unsere Kunden über den gesamten Daten- und KI-Lebenszyklus: von Daten und Datenqualität über KI-Verarbeitung bis zur Integration in produktive Systeme.

Das Projekt

Für einen führenden Telekommunikationskonzern in Deutschland setzen wir Daten- und KI-Projekte auf der Google Cloud um. Mehrere Anwendungsfälle laufen parallel – von Discovery und Business Analyse über PoCs und Entwicklung bis zum Live-Betrieb.

Die Prozesse, die wir automatisieren, sind oft über Jahre gewachsen. Wissen steckt in einzelnen Köpfen, Abläufe sind nur teilweise dokumentiert und Fachbereiche arbeiten mit selbst entwickelten Excel-, Access-, SharePoint- oder anderen Legacy-Lösungen.

Genau dort setzt Deine Rolle an.

Aufgaben

Die Rolle

Du verstehst, was im Fachbereich wirklich passiert – und bereitest es so auf, dass daraus ein umsetzbarer Daten- oder KI-Anwendungsfall entsteht.

Dafür arbeitest Du direkt mit Sachbearbeiter, Projektleitungen und Entscheider. Du findest heraus, wo das eigentliche Problem liegt, welche Regeln tatsächlich gelten und wie ein Prozess funktioniert. Du modellierst Abläufe und Entscheidungslogiken und machst sie für unser Delivery-Team nutzbar.

Dabei gehst Du über klassische Business Analyse hinaus: Du arbeitest heraus, auf welchen Daten ein Prozess basiert, welche Objekte und Beziehungen existieren, aus welchen Systemen die Daten stammen und was in den einzelnen Verarbeitungsschritten mit ihnen passiert.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Solution Architect sowie unseren Data-, AI- und Software-Engineers zusammen. Du musst keine Datenpipeline bauen und keinen produktiven Code schreiben. Du solltest aber Datenflüsse verstehen und einschätzen können, was technisch möglich ist – und was das für den Fachbereich bedeutet.

Gleichzeitig bist Du eine zentrale Ansprechperson für Deine Use Cases: Du gibst Statusupdates, bereitest Entscheidungen vor, managst Erwartungen und treibst offene Punkte voran.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Anforderungen durch Workshops, Interviews und Prozessbeobachtung herausarbeiten – auch wenn Prozesse bisher kaum dokumentiert sind
  • Ist-Prozesse sowie fachliche Regeln und Entscheidungslogiken analysieren und modellieren, insbesondere mit BPMN
  • Datenobjekte, Beziehungen, Quellsysteme und Schlüssel hinter einem Prozess identifizieren und visualisieren
  • Datenflüsse nachvollziehen und Auswirkungen von Datenqualität und Datenverfügbarkeit auf Anforderungen erkennen
  • Prozessdiagramme, Fachkonzepte, Entscheidungsvorlagen und Präsentationen erstellen
  • Stakeholder-Kommunikation und Erwartungsmanagement für Deine Use Cases übernehmen
  • Business Cases sowie KI-, Datenschutz- und Data-Governance-Freigaben beim Kunden begleiten
  • Fachliche Grundlagen für Scoping, Aufwandsschätzungen und Angebote erarbeiten
  • Abhängigkeiten und offene Punkte nachhalten sowie Blocker sichtbar machen und vorantreiben
  • Gemeinsam mit dem Team prüfen, wie Lösungen auf weitere Fachbereiche oder Länder skaliert werden können

Das heutige Team

Du arbeitest in einem interdisziplinären Delivery-Team mit Solution Architecture, Data Engineering, AI Engineering sowie Backend- und Frontend-Entwicklung.

Qualifikation

Must-haves

  • Projekterfahrung in Business Analyse, Prozessberatung, Requirements Engineering, Anforderungsmanagement oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld
  • Erfahrung in der Modellierung von Prozessen und Entscheidungslogiken, idealerweise mit BPMN
  • Ein gutes Verständnis für Datenmodelle und Datenflüsse: Du kannst Objekte, Beziehungen, Quellen und Schlüssel herausarbeiten und nachvollziehen, was mit Daten in einzelnen Verarbeitungsschritten passiert
  • Grundverständnis für KI und KI-gestützte Automatisierung, insbesondere hinsichtlich Datenqualität, Ergebnisqualität und der Grenzen nicht-deterministischer Systeme
  • Kommunikationsstärke und Ownership: Du bringst Themen auch ohne Weisungsbefugnis voran und kannst unterschiedliche Stakeholder sicher abholen
  • Deutsch verhandlungssicher und Englisch fließend

Nice-to-have

  • Erfahrung mit Daten-, Automatisierungs- oder KI-Projekten
  • Erfahrung mit Legacy- oder Shadow-IT-Ablösungen
  • Erfahrung in regulierten oder Governance-intensiven Enterprise-Umgebungen
  • Agile Delivery-Modelle wie Scrum oder SAFe sowie Azure DevOps oder Jira
  • Kenntnisse in Telekommunikation, Infrastruktur, Vertragsmanagement oder Rechnungsprüfung
  • Erste Berührungspunkte mit Google Cloud oder vergleichbaren Datenplattformen

Benefits

  • 30 Tage Urlaub
  • Attraktives Gehalt mit zusätzlicher Erfolgsbeteiligung
  • Betriebliche Weiterbildung und Entwicklung in Richtung Data & AI
  • Firmenevents & Company Offsites
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten & hybrides Arbeitsmodell in Hamburg, Ruhrgebiet und München
  • Auswahl aus verschiedenen Benefits, z. B. Gym Pass oder Deutschlandticket
  • Direkter Zugang zu Fachbereichen und Entscheider beim Kunden
  • Die Möglichkeit, technisch tiefer in Daten, KI und Automatisierung einzusteigen als in vielen klassischen Beratungsrollen

Wir suchen bewusst jemanden auf Mid-Level. Du musst nicht alles am ersten Tag mitbringen. Wichtig sind Prozess- und Datenverständnis, technisches Interesse und die Bereitschaft, tiefer einzusteigen.

Bei uns kannst Du Dich Schritt für Schritt weiterentwickeln: vom Lesen von Datenflüssen zum Verstehen von Code, vom Datenverständnis zum eigenständigen Prüfen mit einfachen SQL-Abfragen oder Skripten und von klassischer Prozessmodellierung hin zu KI-gestützter Analyse und Automatisierung.

So kannst Du zunehmend tiefer in Data, AI und intelligente Prozessautomatisierung einsteigen, ohne Deine Schnittstellenrolle zwischen Fachbereich und Technologie aufzugeben.

Bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns Dich kennenzulernen!

Uns ist weniger wichtig, wie viele Jahre Berufserfahrung du hast oder ob du bereits jede einzelne Aufgabe gemacht hast. Entscheidend ist, wie du denkst, lernst und Dinge vorantreibst und ein maximalen Fokus auf die Interessen unserer User setzt.

Wenn eine Kampagne oder Maßnahme viele Leads liefert, willst du wissen, ob es auch die richtigen sind. Wenn die Conversion sinkt, schaust du auf den gesamten Funnel. Wenn wir im Index sinken interessiert es Dich warum. Und wenn du etwas noch nicht kannst, findest du heraus, wie es funktioniert.

  • Du bringst praktische Erfahrung in Growth, Performance oder Digital Marketing mit und hast in mindestens einem unserer Kernbereiche – SEO, SEA/Paid, CRO oder Marketing Automation – bereits hands-on gearbeitet.
  • LLMs sind für Dich fester Bestandteil Deines Arbeitsalltags. Prompts, APIs und Automatisierung findest du spannend – auch wenn Du selbst kein Developer bist.
  • Du denkst analytisch und hast ein gutes Verständnis für Funnels, Tracking und Performance-KPIs und hast keine Probleme damit, eng mit Product & Tech zusammenzuarbeiten.
  • Du bist technisch neugierig und arbeitest selbstverständlich mit AI-Tools.
  • Du lernst schnell, arbeitest eigenständig und übernimmst Verantwortung für Ergebnisse.

Ein Plus, kein Muss: Erfahrung mit Claude (Code), Chat GPT, Gemini, Google Ads, HubSpot, GA4, Search Console, Meta Ads, Looker Studio, SQL, n8n/Make oder vergleichbaren Tools.

Benefits

  • 🚀 Viel Gestaltungsspielraum und Verantwortung vom ersten Tag an.
  • 🤖 AI als echter Bestandteil von Marketing, Qualifizierung und Customer Journey.
  • 📊 Daten vom ersten Klick bis zur tatsächlichen Conversion.
  • 🧪 Freiheit, neue Ansätze schnell zu testen und erfolgreiche Ideen zu skalieren.
  • 💡 Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit einem erfahrenen Gründer- und Führungsteam, Product, Tech, Sales und Customer Success.
  • 🏡 Flexible Arbeitszeiten, 30 Tage Urlaub sowie die Wahl zwischen unserem Büro in München-Giesing und Remote Work.
  • 📈 Die Möglichkeit, Growth Marketing bei uns maßgeblich mit aufzubauen.
  • 🛠️ Ein modernes Toolset mit Google Workspace, Slack, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, HubSpot, Make und weiteren Tools.

So läuft der Prozess

  • Kennenlernen: 30 Minuten mit unserer Recruiterin – über dich, die Rolle, gegenseitige Erwartungen und die wichtigsten Rahmenbedingungen.
  • Fachgespräch: Wir gehen gemeinsam durch einen echten Fall aus unserem Growth-Funnel und diskutieren, wie du an das Thema herangehen würdest. Keine Case Study, keine Hausaufgabe über Nacht.
  • Team kennenlernen: Im Büro oder per Video lernst du weitere Kolleginnen und Kollegen kennen. Wenn es für beide Seiten passt, folgen zeitnah Entscheidung und Angebot.

Wir halten das Tempo hoch: Du bekommst schnell Feedback und wir schließen den gesamten Prozess innerhalb weniger Wochen ab.

Klingt spannend?

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf oder dein LinkedIn-Profil.

Noch spannender als perfekte Stationen finden wir, was du selbst aufgebaut, optimiert oder herausgefunden hast – egal ob SEO-Projekt, Kampagne, Funnel, Automation oder AI-Experiment.

title: (Senior) People Operations & Excellence Manager (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at plancraft
description_html:
OUR PURPOSE AT PLANCRAFT

Building the backbone of European trades – together, with modern software and smart AI solutions.
We don’t just develop software – we’re on a mission to give tradespeople and contractors more room to focus on what matters. We do this by providing a practical SaaS solution that works the way they do: fast, efficient, and without unnecessary administrative overhead. Supported by smart AI features exactly where they make a real difference in everyday work.
Backed by Tier 1 investors from Europe and the US such as Headline and Creandum, and with more than 30,000 craftspeople as our customer base, we are scaling across Europe to turn individual, scattered businesses into connected and successful communities.
We believe in zero admin, not zero personality – and we build every feature with the people wearing safety boots in mind, not suits. We’re excited to shape the future together as a team, staying grounded in our mission to empower the builders and makers of tomorrow.

YOUR MISSION AT PLANCRAFT

As (Senior) People Operations & Excellence Manager, you build and continuously improve the operational foundations that enable our People Operations & Partnering function to scale. You design efficient processes, strengthen our systems, automate repetitive work, and create the standards that allow managers and employees to navigate People Operations matters with ease.

As plancraft continues to grow with 160+ employees across Germany and Europe, this role is key to building a scalable, data-driven, and future-ready People Operations function. You combine reliable operational execution with a continuous improvement mindset—using day-to-day operational insights to simplify workflows, improve data quality, expand self-service, and drive practical automation across the employee lifecycle.

Next to the operational day-to-day business, a key part of your role is translating operational insights into better processes. You design standardized workflows, build SOPs and knowledge resources, improve data quality and reporting, and identify practical opportunities to leverage automation and AI across our People Operations landscape. Working closely with stakeholders across the business, you help establish an integrated operating model that combines operational reliability with continuous improvement.

You will work particularly closely with:

  • our Lead People Operations & Partnering, who will be your direct manager and strategic counterpart for continuously evolving our People Operations & Partnering model across Germany and international locations.

  • our broader People & Organization team, to align seamless end-to-end people processes.

  • technical stakeholders, to bring more complex processes and automations to life.

  • employees across the organization, you are supporting in their employee lifecycle.

This is a role with broad cross-functional exposure, significant ownership, and the opportunity to shape how People Operations scales at plancraft. If you enjoy combining operational excellence with systems thinking, process design, automation, and continuous improvement, you'll have the opportunity to leave a lasting impact on one of the company's core enabling functions.


Your Responsibilities

End-to-End People Operations

  • Own the day-to-day delivery of parts of our core People Operations processes, including HRIS administration (Personio), contract amendments, payroll inputs, employee data management, and recurring documentation requests.

  • Ensure reliable, compliant, and high-quality execution across the entire employee lifecycle

  • Support the operational implementation of international employment setups, entity transitions, and evolving People Operations requirements as we continue to grow across Europe.

Operational Excellence, Automation & Insights

  • Own the continuous improvement of People Operations processes by identifying repetitive friction, manual effort, unclear handovers and opportunities to simplify or standardize how work gets done.

  • Design better end-to-end workflows and implement practical improvements through existing tools, low-code or no-code solutions, AI-enabled workflows and scalable self-service formats.

  • Lead automation initiatives from problem identification and process design through implementation and adoption, partnering with internal technical experts where deeper integrations or more complex builds are required.

  • Build ways to monitor meaningful operational metrics, create dashboards and reporting and translate data and operational patterns into concrete recommendations, improvement priorities and accessible insights for relevant stakeholders.

  • Continuously develop and maintain the manager enablement and self-service ecosystem, including practical guides, playbooks, templates, knowledge resources and learning formats.

 

YOUR PROFILE

Must-Have Skills

  • 2–3 years of experience in People Operations, or a comparable operational People role.

  • Proven experience in managing core employee lifecycle processes, including HR administration, contract management, payroll inputs, and HRIS maintenance.

  • Strong process thinking with a passion for improving workflows rather than simply executing them with high affinity for HR systems, structured documentation, and data quality.

  • Experience managing operational employee and manager requests with accuracy, reliability, and a strong service mindset.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify patterns, prioritize improvements, and translate insights into scalable solutions.

  • Great curiosity and ideally first experiences in applying automation and AI to improve operational efficiency.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in German & English (C1/C2 level); additional European languages are a plus.

  • Experience in a scale-up or high-growth environment .

  • Located within Germany with willingness to come to our Hamburg HQs minimum once per quarter.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Working in an HR function in a company with international employment setups.

  • Familiarity with Personio, Leapsome, Notion, Slack Workflows, or similar HR technology.

  • Exposure to no-code automation, AI-assisted workflows, or reporting and dashboard tools.

  • Additional European language skills.



Who this Role is for
You're someone who enjoys bringing structure to complexity. Rather than accepting inefficient processes, you naturally look for better ways of working and get energy from making systems simpler, smarter, and more scalable.

You enjoy balancing hands-on operational work with continuous improvement. Solving recurring challenges through better processes, automation, AI, and self-service feels just as rewarding as delivering an excellent employee experience in the day-to-day.

You are someone who:

  • enjoys building scalable processes instead of repeatedly solving the same problem

  • combines operational excellence with a pragmatic, hands-on mindset

  • naturally spots inefficiencies and turns them into practical improvements

  • is curious about leveraging AI and automation to simplify repetitive work

  • enjoys creating clarity through documentation, playbooks, and structured ways of working

  • uses data and operational insights to prioritize improvements and measure impact

  • takes ownership while collaborating closely with colleagues across the business

  • values accuracy, reliability, and compliance without losing sight of the employee experience

  • enjoys building solutions that make life easier for managers, employees, and the People team alike

If you're excited by the idea of building a tech & AI-powered operational backbone that enables our People function to scale, we'd love to meet you.

 

WHY PLANCRAFT?

 

  • Team Spirit: We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. Team spirit matters to us — and we make it visible: with four major team event weeks per year, casual monthly on-site and remote formats, and a strong recognition culture where we regularly celebrate both the big and small wins together.

  • Ownership: You’re encouraged to take ownership from day one. In a flat hierarchy and high-trust environment, you’re empowered to make meaningful decisions and drive real impact.

  • Learning & Growth: We invest in your personal and professional development through a strong feedback culture with 6-monthly 360° growth reviews, a personal learning budget (1.500€/year), 2 paid days of educational leave, and targeted enablement formats. Our goal is to help you unlock your full potential.

  • AI Enablement: Our internal tools and workflows are AI-enabled by design. We support every team and individual in applying AI at the next level in their daily work.

  • Tech & Tooling: You’ll receive a MacBook, premium headphones, and everything else you need — from hardware to tools — to be effective in your daily doing.

  • Flexibility: Whether remote, hybrid, abroad or on-site — you work where you’re at your best. Our Hamburg office (with a rooftop terrace) is always open, and you decide each week how often you come in. And if you need a change of scenery, working abroad worldwide up to 2 months is always an option.

  • Recharge: To ensure the needed rest, we offer 30 vacation days per year (based on a 5-day week) plus Dec 24th off. We also subsidize your Urban Sports Club membership and organize internal sport meetups.

  • Mobility: You can lease a "JobRad" (Bike) and get a subsidized "Deutschlandticket" or "BahnCard" for public transport to be supported in your commute.

  • International Environment: We’re becoming more international every month, with team members already in Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, and Austria — which is why English is our internal company language.

 

We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. For a first impression of us, take a look at our Instagram and LinkedIn page.

Diversity makes us better.
We welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and experiences, and we believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, stronger products, and a healthier workplace. If you’re excited about our mission but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be exactly who we’re looking for.

______

On the application process
We want your candidate experience with us to be smooth, transparent, and enjoyable. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process typically takes about 4 weeks from start to finish, though this may vary by role. You can learn more about our process here. If you need adjustments or flexibility at any stage, please don’t hesitate to let us know — we’ll do our best to make it work for you.

Note on creating a test account:
If you would like to create a test account as part of the challenge, please enter "Applicant" in the relevant field during registration and select "Other" under Trade. This ensures that our sales team does not mistakenly register you as a craft business and reach out to you unnecessarily.

Compensation: €57.5K – €70K

description_html:
About Uplane (YC F25)

Companies waste billions on bad ads, mismatched landing pages, and poor budget allocation. Uplane fixes this by replacing a patchwork of agencies, spreadsheets, and siloed tools with one self-improving AI system. It creates ads, builds matching landing pages, allocates budgets across different channels, and more. We are building the AI engine that will manage and spend the world's marketing budget.

About The Role

We're seeking a hands-on Forward Deployed Engineer to be the technical backbone of our managed service business. Your job is to make AI-generated landing pages convert and measure correctly: set up and test performance-marketing tracking, wire up commerce and conversion features, fix and fine-tune pages, and act as the technical point of contact for our clients. The work sits between engineering and client relations.

Why Join

  • Be an early team member at a well-funded, YC-backed startup

  • Solve a massive problem in a massive market

  • Take ownership and grow quickly; your work directly drives client results (and revenue)

  • Remote-first contract with a fast-moving, ambitious, fun, humble team

Responsibilities

  • Performance Marketing Tracking: Set up, implement, and test conversion tracking on landing pages.

  • Conversion & Commerce Integrations: Integrate purchase and checkout features (e.g. Shopify) so customers can buy directly on the AI-built landing pages. Wire up forms, payment flows, and webhooks.

  • Landing Page Fixes & Fine-Tuning: Debug, polish, and fine-tune landing pages built by our AI marketing strategists, including front-end fixes, responsive issues, layout, and page speed.

  • Client Tech Support: Be the technical point of contact for our clients via Slack. Troubleshoot issues, communicate clearly and proactively, and own problems through to resolution.

  • Learn, Adapt & Automate: Our stack keeps growing. Stay curious and flexible, picking up new tracking tools, integrations, and platforms as our needs evolve. Automate as much of your own work as you can.

Requirements

  • Some Front-end coding experience: You're comfortable building and editing responsive front-ends with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Junior candidates are welcome, and we care more about raw ability and drive than years of experience.

  • Hard-working, smart, and humble. You take ownership and are willing to solve whatever problem you or the customers may face. You don't give up until the issue is solved.

  • A people person with fluent written English. You'll support clients directly over Slack, so you communicate clearly, proactively, and with patience.

  • A fast learner and problem-solver: You're excited to pick up performance-marketing tracking and new tools quickly. No prior tracking experience required.

Nice to Have (not required)

  • Experience with performance-marketing tracking (GTM, GA4, pixels, conversion APIs): a real plus, but not required, and we'll help you learn it

  • Experience integrating Shopify or checkout/payment flows

  • Previous touchpoints with marketing, AdTech, or an agency/consulting environment

Tech Stack (what you'll work with)

  • Tracking & Analytics: Google Tag Manager, GA4, Meta Pixel + Conversions API, Google Ads / TikTok / LinkedIn pixels

  • Commerce & Integrations: Shopify, checkout/payment, forms, webhooks

  • Front-end: HTML, CSS, JavaScript

  • Collaboration: Slack, Notion, Linear

  • …and more. Our stack evolves, so flexibility to learn new tools is expected

Compensation: €60K – €80K

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - Berlin
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Uplane
description_html:
About Uplane (YC F25)

Companies waste billions on bad ads, mismatched landing pages, and poor budget allocation. Uplane fixes this by replacing a patchwork of agencies, spreadsheets, and siloed tools with one self-improving AI system. It creates ads, builds matching landing pages, allocates budgets across different channels, and more. We are building the AI engine that will manage and spend the world's marketing budget.

About The Role

We're seeking a hands-on Forward Deployed Engineer to be the technical backbone of our managed service business. Your job is to make AI-generated landing pages convert and measure correctly: set up and test performance-marketing tracking, wire up commerce and conversion features, fix and fine-tune pages, and act as the technical point of contact for our clients. The work sits between engineering and client relations.

Why Join

  • Be an early team member at a well-funded, YC-backed startup

  • Solve a massive problem in a massive market

  • Take ownership and grow quickly; your work directly drives client results (and revenue)

  • Remote-first contract with a fast-moving, ambitious, fun, humble team

Responsibilities

  • Performance Marketing Tracking: Set up, implement, and test conversion tracking on landing pages.

  • Conversion & Commerce Integrations: Integrate purchase and checkout features (e.g. Shopify) so customers can buy directly on the AI-built landing pages. Wire up forms, payment flows, and webhooks.

  • Landing Page Fixes & Fine-Tuning: Debug, polish, and fine-tune landing pages built by our AI marketing strategists, including front-end fixes, responsive issues, layout, and page speed.

  • Client Tech Support: Be the technical point of contact for our clients via Slack. Troubleshoot issues, communicate clearly and proactively, and own problems through to resolution.

  • Learn, Adapt & Automate: Our stack keeps growing. Stay curious and flexible, picking up new tracking tools, integrations, and platforms as our needs evolve. Automate as much of your own work as you can.

Requirements

  • Some Front-end coding experience: You're comfortable building and editing responsive front-ends with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Junior candidates are welcome, and we care more about raw ability and drive than years of experience.

  • Hard-working, smart, and humble. You take ownership and are willing to solve whatever problem you or the customers may face. You don't give up until the issue is solved.

  • A people person with fluent written English. You'll support clients directly over Slack, so you communicate clearly, proactively, and with patience.

  • A fast learner and problem-solver: You're excited to pick up performance-marketing tracking and new tools quickly. No prior tracking experience required.

Nice to Have (not required)

  • Experience with performance-marketing tracking (GTM, GA4, pixels, conversion APIs): a real plus, but not required, and we'll help you learn it

  • Experience integrating Shopify or checkout/payment flows

  • Previous touchpoints with marketing, AdTech, or an agency/consulting environment

Tech Stack (what you'll work with)

  • Tracking & Analytics: Google Tag Manager, GA4, Meta Pixel + Conversions API, Google Ads / TikTok / LinkedIn pixels

  • Commerce & Integrations: Shopify, checkout/payment, forms, webhooks

  • Front-end: HTML, CSS, JavaScript

  • Collaboration: Slack, Notion, Linear

  • …and more. Our stack evolves, so flexibility to learn new tools is expected

Compensation: €60K – €80K

  • • €60K – €80K

title: Account Executive, DACH
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Netboxlabs
description_html:
NetBox Labs is seeking a Senior Account Executive (AE) to play a pivotal role in the growth and expansion of our business in the DACH region. You will be tasked with proactive outbound prospecting and managing inbound leads. Given the technical nature of our product, a high technical aptitude is crucial to understand and articulate the value proposition effectively to potential clients. You will be responsible for the entire sales cycle, including the initial prospecting, qualification, technical discussions, pricing and contract negotiation, deal closure, and expansion. This role demands a combination of technical understanding, sales acumen, and relationship-building skills to drive significant impact and contribute to the company's success.

 

In this role, you will:

 

  • Proactively build, qualify, and close a new logo sales pipeline, ensuring you meet or exceed quota and drive steady bookings growth.

  • Be responsible for outbound motions to create pipeline.

  • Strategically prospect into Network Engineering management & technical end users, understanding their unique challenges and requirements.

  • Build strong and effective relationships with prospects using a consultative sales approach, leading to increased trust and deal velocity.

  • Work on both the acquisition of net new customers and the revenue expansion of existing customer accounts.

  • Work with the Channel team to develop indirect opportunities.

  • Work with the Customer Success team for expansion into existing accounts.

  • Build and manage accurate forecast and opportunity progress reporting.

  • Partner with our Solutions Engineers to ensure technical alignment and convey NetBox Labs’ value proposition and key differentiators.

  • Continually seek to improve your selling skills and iterate/improve on the sales process.

  • Develop an understanding of the partner ecosystem and competitive solutions.

 
 

Requirements:

 

  • 5+ years of SaaS/Networking Equipment field experience with quota-carrying roles in fast-paced markets in DACH, focused on closing net new logos and demonstrating the ability to run complex sales processes. Experience working with open source technology is a plus.

  • 1+ years of experience working in a collaborative startup environment.

  • An entrepreneurial and self-starter mentality with the ability to roll up your sleeves and get involved with many aspects of selling to “get it done”

  • A history of overachievement and consistently hitting or exceeding sales targets.

  • Proficiency in managing both inbound leads and outbound prospecting to build a robust pipeline.

  • Drive and competitiveness, underlined by a strong desire to win.

  • Technical aptitude and exceptional ability to articulate the business value of complex, technical enterprise products built on open source technology. Previous experience as a sales engineer or network engineer is a plus.

  • Specialized knowledge in Networking, Network Engineering, Network Automation would be a significant advantage.

About NetBox Labs:

NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.

NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.

NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital.

Our culture and values:

  • We own and solve problems with high attention to detail.

  • Our open source contributors, users, customers & team are all part of our community. When our community wins, we win.

  • We prioritize simplicity and think twice before adding complexity

  • Clear communication helps keep our team aligned and collaborating smoothly.

NetBox Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better software, and we welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, and veteran status. If you need accommodation at any point in the process, just let us know.

 

Compensation: €90K – €100K • Offers Equity • €90K – €100K Bonus

title: Director AI Platform Engineering
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Deeptech Recruitment
description_html:
Our client is building a new AI Engineering & Platform team in Germany to support the next generation of AI-powered media, localization, automation, and workflow capabilities. The Director, AI Engineering & Platform will lead this team and will be responsible for building, operating, and evolving the technical foundation for production AI services across our client.

This is a senior hands-on leadership role for someone who can build and run a high-performing engineering team, deliver complex AI platform and integration projects, and provide technical direction across cloud infrastructure, model deployment, AI services, agentic workflows, and production operations. The role will lead a hybrid engineering team based primarily in Germany while also managing and collaborating with engineers in other our client locations, including the United States.

In addition to leading delivery and operations, this person will continuously evaluate emerging AI technologies, model providers, open-source frameworks, agentic workflow patterns, and industry capabilities. They will be expected to make clear recommendations on where our client should build, buy, partner, or integrate in order to improve speed, quality, cost, automation, and product differentiation.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Build, lead, mentor, and develop a distributed AI engineering team across Germany and other our client locations. Experience recruiting, hiring, and standing up the full AI/ML engineering organization from scratch: applied ML engineers, MLOps/platform engineers, data engineers, integration engineers, etc.

  • Lead development, hosting and ongoing improvement of our client’s cloud-native training and inference platform (compute, storage, orchestration, model serving, monitoring, cost management) for our client’s NLP technology for MT, ASR, and TTS in production.

  • Own technical delivery for our client’s AI platform, model-serving, workflow automation, and applied AI engineering initiatives.

  • Lead architecture,execution, deployment and SLA performance for scalable AI services, including inference platforms, training environments, deployment pipelines, observability, and operational support.

  • Own infrastructure cost efficiency (GPU utilization, training vs. inference cost trade-offs, autoscaling) as a first-class, ongoing responsibility rather than a one-time setup task.

  • Evaluate internal and external AI technologies on an ongoing basis, including commercial models, open-source models, agentic frameworks, orchestration tools, and vendor platforms.

  • Recommend when our client should build, buy, partner, or integrate with third-party AI capabilities.

  • Guide teams responsible for cloud infrastructure, DevOps, AI platform operations, applied AI engineering, and model integration.

  • Establish engineering standards, operating rhythms, delivery practices, documentation expectations, and technical review processes.

  • Establish and drive MLOps practices: continuous improvement across AI engineering practices, reproducible training pipelines, model versioning and registry, automation, CI/CD, monitoring, automated quality evaluation, testing, and release management.

  • Support adoption of AI capabilities across our client applications and workflows through reusable platforms, services, APIs, and technical patterns.

  • Create clarity around priorities, risks, technical tradeoffs, delivery timelines, and resourcing needs.

  • Ensure the team can operate production AI systems independently through strong documentation, runbooks, monitoring, incident response, and knowledge sharing.

  • Partner with U.S. and European stakeholders across engineering, product, operations, localization, media workflows, and business leadership. Partner closely with the leaders of our client’s localization business lines to understand where current MT/ASR/TTS quality falls short and translate that into a prioritized technical roadmap.

  • Ensure AI systems are reliable, secure, maintainable, cost-conscious, and aligned with production business needs.

  • Represent AI/ML technology capability and constraints to executive leadership; contribute to the company's overall technology and product strategy.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • [10+] years in software/ML engineering, including [4+] years in a technical leadership role owning both people management and architecture/system-design decisions.

  • Direct, hands-on experience with model training/fine-tuning, evaluation methodology, and production deployment (not solely API-consumer experience).

  • Proven experience designing and operating production ML infrastructure at scale: training pipelines, model serving/inference, GPU resource management, and MLOps tooling, on at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Experience in distributed training, Slurm/HPC, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, or similar infrastructure technologies.

  • Track record of building a technical team from scratch to a functioning, multi-workstream organization, including recruiting, leveling, and distributed team design across locations and time zones.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate business/product requirements from non-technical stakeholders into a technical roadmap, and to communicate technical trade-offs to executives in business terms.

  • Significant experience leading engineering teams responsible for cloud platforms, AI/ML systems, data platforms, workflow automation, or production software systems.

  • Strong technical background in cloud architecture, software engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, or AI/ML engineering.

  • Experience with agentic workflows, LLM orchestration, model evaluation, RAG patterns, or AI-enabled automation platforms.

  • Experience evaluating commercial and open-source AI models or vendor platforms.

  • Experience delivering production systems that require reliability, monitoring, automation, security, and operational ownership.

  • Strong understanding of modern AI architectures, model-serving patterns, APIs, data pipelines, and applied AI integration.

  • Ability to evaluate technical options, make pragmatic recommendations, and communicate tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Experience leading complex technical programs from planning through production deployment and ongoing operations.

  • Ability to work effectively with U.S.-based leadership while operating independently from Germany.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience with speech, language, localization, dubbing, media workflows, ASR, MT, TTS, or content-processing systems.

  • Prior experience in media, localization, entertainment technology, or a related content-production industry — direct exposure to subtitling, dubbing, or content compliance workflows is a strong plus.

  • Familiarity with content-security frameworks used by major studios and broadcasters (e.g., MPA content security best practices, Trusted Partner Network) and what they require of vendor/internal systems.

  • Prior experience taking over or migrating away from a third-party AI/ML vendor relationship, including contract wind-down and knowledge-transfer.

  • Experience in media, entertainment, localization, post-production, or content supply chain environments.

title: Staff Fullstack Engineer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Deeptech Recruitment
description_html:
Deep Tech Recruitment is partnering with a Speedinvest venture-backed European AI company building the modern software backbone for specialist pharmaceutical and chemical manufacturers.

Its mission is to strengthen the resilience of essential European supply chains by helping manufacturers overcome skilled labour shortages, respond faster to disruption and reduce the operational risk created by ageing ERP systems, spreadsheets and fragmented knowledge. The business is developing an AI-native operating environment that provides consistent data and intelligent workflows across order management, production planning, materials planning and procurement, while retaining the human oversight required in regulated industries.

The company

The company is building an AI native software backbone for specialist manufacturers, initially across mission critical pharmaceutical and chemical supply chains. Many of these businesses still run critical order, planning and procurement processes through ageing ERP systems, spreadsheets and knowledge held by a small number of experienced employees.

The product combines workflow automation, AI agents and human approval to help operational teams respond faster while maintaining accuracy, traceability and compliance. The engineering team works close to customers, including visits to operational environments, to understand how work happens and turn it into dependable software.

The role

As an early staff engineering hire, you will help shape the platform from its first production versions. This is a hands on full stack role with strong backend ownership. You will work directly with the founders, influence architecture and engineering standards, and stay close to the users whose workflows you are improving.

Why consider it

You will have meaningful influence over the architecture, product and early engineering culture.

The technical work combines AI enabled systems, enterprise integration and demanding operational constraints.

The product supports essential European industries where software reliability and human judgement both matter.

The package includes a competitive base salary and meaningful early stage equity through a VSOP.

What you will do

  • Build end to end product features with TypeScript, Node.js, React and Next.js.

  • Design and evolve backend services, APIs and system architecture for complex operational workflows.

  • Model and optimise data in PostgreSQL, with attention to reliability, performance and auditability.

  • Develop multi step AI agent workflows with validation logic, evaluations, monitoring and human approval points.

  • Integrate with enterprise systems including ERPs, communication tools and document platforms through REST APIs and other interfaces.

  • Support cloud and on premises deployments, working directly with customer IT teams where required.

  • Build secure, traceable workflows suitable for regulated environments and contribute to audit readiness and compliance documentation.

  • Join customer conversations, understand real operating constraints and translate them into product and technical decisions.

  • Help establish the engineering culture, technical bar and practical ways of working for the team as it grows.

What AI native means here

The company uses external language models and coding agents to build and ship software faster. The role involves engineering reliable AI enabled workflows around those models. It does not involve training foundation models or conducting AI research. Strong software engineering judgement remains central, particularly around evaluation, failure modes, observability and human oversight.

What you bring

  • Around 3 to 5 or more years of experience building and operating production software.

  • Strong backend engineering skills with Node.js, API design and system architecture.

  • Solid PostgreSQL experience, including data modelling and query optimisation.

  • Experience integrating REST APIs and external systems.

  • The ability to work across the stack using JavaScript or TypeScript and React or Next.js.

  • A hands on approach. You can reason about architecture and still write, test and ship production code.

  • Fluent English for technical collaboration and customer conversations.

  • The willingness to work with the team from the Berlin office five days a week.

Useful additional experience

  • Enterprise software or products built for regulated, high security environments.

  • LLM integrations using providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic or Google, including evaluation and monitoring.

  • ERP integrations such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Infor.

  • Cloud infrastructure, DevOps and connections to on premises or legacy systems.

  • German language skills for direct customer communication.

  • Strong product and UX instincts, or experience working with design systems.

How the team works

  • High ownership and direct access to the founding team.

  • Fast iteration informed by customer workflows and operational reality.

  • Clear expectations, practical decision making and space to shape how engineering is done.

  • A long term product build with the opportunity to grow into broader technical leadership as the team expands.

Interview process

The process combines founder & engineering conversations with practical technical assessment. You should expect an architecture discussion and a hands-on coding exercise focused on how you think, communicate and build with modern engineering tools, including AI-assisted development.

Inclusion and accessibility

Our client is committed to an inclusive environment in which people of every gender identity, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, neurotype and disability can belong and contribute. Diverse teams make better decisions, and equity is treated as a condition for innovation.

If you need reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process, including assistive technology, additional time or another format, tell your Deep Tech Recruitment contact and we will support you.

BUILD THE IMPOSSIBLE. WE’LL FIND THE PEOPLE.

Deep Tech Recruitment connects ambitious technology companies with the engineers and leaders who can turn difficult ideas into products that perform in the real world.

title: Staff Fullstack Engineer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Deeptech Recruitment
description_html:
Deep Tech Recruitment is partnering with a Speedinvest venture-backed European AI company building the modern software backbone for specialist pharmaceutical and chemical manufacturers.

Its mission is to strengthen the resilience of essential European supply chains by helping manufacturers overcome skilled labour shortages, respond faster to disruption and reduce the operational risk created by ageing ERP systems, spreadsheets and fragmented knowledge. The business is developing an AI-native operating environment that provides consistent data and intelligent workflows across order management, production planning, materials planning and procurement, while retaining the human oversight required in regulated industries.

The company

The company is building an AI native software backbone for specialist manufacturers, initially across mission critical pharmaceutical and chemical supply chains. Many of these businesses still run critical order, planning and procurement processes through ageing ERP systems, spreadsheets and knowledge held by a small number of experienced employees.

The product combines workflow automation, AI agents and human approval to help operational teams respond faster while maintaining accuracy, traceability and compliance. The engineering team works close to customers, including visits to operational environments, to understand how work happens and turn it into dependable software.

The role

As an early staff engineering hire, you will help shape the platform from its first production versions. This is a hands on full stack role with strong backend ownership. You will work directly with the founders, influence architecture and engineering standards, and stay close to the users whose workflows you are improving.

Why consider it

You will have meaningful influence over the architecture, product and early engineering culture.

The technical work combines AI enabled systems, enterprise integration and demanding operational constraints.

The product supports essential European industries where software reliability and human judgement both matter.

The package includes a competitive base salary and meaningful early stage equity through a VSOP.

What you will do

  • Build end to end product features with TypeScript, Node.js, React and Next.js.

  • Design and evolve backend services, APIs and system architecture for complex operational workflows.

  • Model and optimise data in PostgreSQL, with attention to reliability, performance and auditability.

  • Develop multi step AI agent workflows with validation logic, evaluations, monitoring and human approval points.

  • Integrate with enterprise systems including ERPs, communication tools and document platforms through REST APIs and other interfaces.

  • Support cloud and on premises deployments, working directly with customer IT teams where required.

  • Build secure, traceable workflows suitable for regulated environments and contribute to audit readiness and compliance documentation.

  • Join customer conversations, understand real operating constraints and translate them into product and technical decisions.

  • Help establish the engineering culture, technical bar and practical ways of working for the team as it grows.

What AI native means here

The company uses external language models and coding agents to build and ship software faster. The role involves engineering reliable AI enabled workflows around those models. It does not involve training foundation models or conducting AI research. Strong software engineering judgement remains central, particularly around evaluation, failure modes, observability and human oversight.

What you bring

  • Around 3 to 5 or more years of experience building and operating production software.

  • Strong backend engineering skills with Node.js, API design and system architecture.

  • Solid PostgreSQL experience, including data modelling and query optimisation.

  • Experience integrating REST APIs and external systems.

  • The ability to work across the stack using JavaScript or TypeScript and React or Next.js.

  • A hands on approach. You can reason about architecture and still write, test and ship production code.

  • Fluent English for technical collaboration and customer conversations.

  • The willingness to work with the team from the Berlin office five days a week.

Useful additional experience

  • Enterprise software or products built for regulated, high security environments.

  • LLM integrations using providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic or Google, including evaluation and monitoring.

  • ERP integrations such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Infor.

  • Cloud infrastructure, DevOps and connections to on premises or legacy systems.

  • German language skills for direct customer communication.

  • Strong product and UX instincts, or experience working with design systems.

How the team works

  • High ownership and direct access to the founding team.

  • Fast iteration informed by customer workflows and operational reality.

  • Clear expectations, practical decision making and space to shape how engineering is done.

  • A long term product build with the opportunity to grow into broader technical leadership as the team expands.

Interview process

The process combines founder & engineering conversations with practical technical assessment. You should expect an architecture discussion and a hands-on coding exercise focused on how you think, communicate and build with modern engineering tools, including AI-assisted development.

Inclusion and accessibility

Our client is committed to an inclusive environment in which people of every gender identity, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, neurotype and disability can belong and contribute. Diverse teams make better decisions, and equity is treated as a condition for innovation.

If you need reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process, including assistive technology, additional time or another format, tell your Deep Tech Recruitment contact and we will support you.

BUILD THE IMPOSSIBLE. WE’LL FIND THE PEOPLE.

Deep Tech Recruitment connects ambitious technology companies with the engineers and leaders who can turn difficult ideas into products that perform in the real world.

title: Senior Platform Engineer with Security Focus - Remote (Germany)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Mondoo
description_html:
Mondoo is creating a new way that helps companies keep their users and data safe from hackers around the world. We believe that a great user experience and visual design will help our users to love and enjoy our product and make it easier to take action against attackers.

Your impact

You will have a direct impact on the Mondoo Platform including our policy engine, resources, scale, and multi-region functionality. You will be helping teams to assess, scope, prioritize, triage and remediate security findings.

Key responsibilities

We're seeking a talented Platform Engineer who is eager to enhance their expertise in security. This position offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and gain hands-on experience in "policy as code" frameworks while contributing to our dynamic team.

In this role, you will:

  • Build, manage, and optimize cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform and CloudFormation.

  • Automate system configurations using tools like Ansible, Puppet, or Chef.

  • Collaborate with teams to ensure seamless integration of infrastructure with CI/CD pipelines.

  • Gain experience working with policy as code frameworks (e.g., Open Policy Agent, HashiCorp Sentinel).

  • Assist in translating high-level security requirements into practical policy as code implementation within cloud and on-premises environments.

  • Support the implementation and scaling of automated security controls in Kubernetes, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), and operating systems.x5

  • Stay updated on infrastructure management and automation trends, ensuring a robust and scalable system foundation

Required qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience with IaC tools like Terraform or CloudFormation.

  • Proficiency in configuration management tools such as Ansible, Puppet, or Chef.

  • Solid understanding of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and its core services.

  • Experience working with container technologies like Docker and orchestration tools like Kubernetes.

  • Comfortable scripting in at least one language (e.g., Python, Bash, or similar).

  • Knowledge of networking basics (TCP/IP, DNS, etc.).

  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git).

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

  • Willingness to learn and grow into a role focused on security policies and automation.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.

Preferred qualifications

  • Familiarity with security tools and concepts such as policy as code frameworks (Open Policy Agent, Sentinel).

  • Knowledge of compliance standards (e.g., CIS, SOC 2, ISO 27001).

  • Previous exposure to cloud-native security tools and services.

  • Relevant certifications in cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).

  • A keen interest in learning about security best practices, frameworks, and tools.

Application Process

As part of your application, please share links to your GitHub/GitLab repositories or a portfolio of projects that demonstrate your experience with security policy implementation, policy as code, and relevant cloud security tools. We're particularly interested in seeing examples that showcase your ability to translate complex security requirements into executable code for cloud environments.

If you're passionate about enhancing cloud security through code, implementing scalable and automated security policies across cloud platforms, participating in collaborative security design processes, and staying at the forefront of cloud security best practices, we'd love to hear from you!

About Artificial

Help shape the future of specialty insurance

At Artificial, we’re building the next generation of technology for the specialty (re)insurance market. Our mission is to transform how brokers and carriers operate in complex markets by removing operational barriers and enabling smarter, faster decision-making.

We use modern technology to solve real challenges for some of the world’s leading brokers and insurers. By automating the repetitive and structuring the complex, we help our partners unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth.

You’ll be joining a collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. We work in an environment where ideas are heard, support is built-in, and outcomes matter. Everyone here has the chance to make a tangible impact on our products, our customers, and the industry.

We've just raised $45M (£33M) in Series B funding from lead investor CommerzVentures, new investor Move Capital, as well as all existing shareholders. This investment round gives us the room to grow with confidence, continue to innovate, and ensure that Artificial remains the first choice for brokers and carriers seeking a smarter way to trade digitally.

Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations.

About the role

As Sales Manager at Artificial, you'll own new business growth across specialty (re)insurance carriers, MGAs, and brokers in Germany and the broader DACH region. This is a full-cycle sales role: you'll build pipeline, run the sales process end to end, and close deals with senior stakeholders who are rethinking how their underwriting and claims operations run.

Day to day, you'll:

  • Prospect, qualify, and manage a pipeline of specialty (re)insurance carriers, MGAs, and brokers across Germany/DACH (and, over time, wider Europe)

  • Build and manage relationships with senior stakeholders - Chief Underwriting Officers, Heads of Digital/IT, and other economic buyers

  • Run the full sales cycle: discovery, demo (partnering with our Pre-Sales Engineer for technical validation), proposal, negotiation, and close

  • Keep an accurate, disciplined pipeline in the CRM and forecast reliably against quarterly and annual targets

  • Work closely with Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to share market feedback and shape go-to-market strategy for the region and beyond

  • Represent Artificial at industry conferences and broker/carrier events across Europe

About you

  • A track record of success in B2B SaaS sales, ideally selling into insurance, financial services, or complex enterprise software

  • Alternatively: UWing/Broking??

  • Experience selling technical or API-driven products to enterprise buyers, and comfort running a consultative, solution-based sales process

  • Existing relationships or experience within the European (re)insurance market are a strong plus

  • Fluent in German and English

  • Based in Germany, remote, with willingness to travel within Europe as the role requires

  • A consistent history of meeting or exceeding quota

  • An entrepreneurial, self-directed approach — comfortable building process rather than just following it, in a fast-moving Series B environment

We especially want to hear from you if you have

  • Collaborative skills with an emphasis on product quality.

  • Experience in insurtech, insurance or related industries.

  • Strong problem-solving skills.

  • Experience in a distributed work environment.


    We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities around us. If there’s anything you need to make the hiring process more accessible, just let us know—we’re happy to make adjustments. You’re also welcome to share your preferred pronouns with us at any point.


    Think you don’t meet every requirement? Please apply anyway. We value potential as much as experience, and we know that raw talent counts.


    As part of our hiring process, we’ll carry out some background checks. These may include a criminal record check, reviewing your credit history, speaking with previous employers and confirming your academic qualifications.

title: Principal Thermal-Mechanical Engineer-Munich, Germany

description_html:
About Us

We are building Physics AI for hardware design. Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows.

Our first product bridges the gap between the accuracy & determinism of traditional simulation and the speed & scaling of AI, and is redefining how the world’s most advanced semiconductors are designed, verified, built, brought to market and integrated in complex systems.

Role Overview

As a pivotal leader within our European Forward Deployment team, you will drive the adoption of Vinci’s platform among the region's top engineering organizations. In this strategic role, you will build, mentor, and guide a high-performing team of thermal engineers dedicated to engaging prospective customers and demonstrating our software's transformative value.

As trusted technical advisors, you and your team will use deep simulation expertise to help enterprise customers validate and optimize complex, real-world designs. Through these collaborative engagements, you will champion Vinci's value proposition by showing how our platform delivers systemic improvements in thermal performance, product reliability, and time-to-market.

Leveraging strong fundamentals in continuum mechanics, you will guide analyses of complex physical phenomena, including linear, geometric and material nonlinearities, and contact interactions. Your team will evaluate critical factors such as warpage, stress evolution, thermal cycling, and reliability across advanced semiconductor devices, electronics packages, and wafer-scale systems.

You will work closely with customer engineering teams to understand their technical challenges, provide expert guidance, and clearly articulate Vinci’s capabilities in solving real-world problems. You will also serve as a key feedback channel to product and engineering teams, translating customer insights into actionable inputs that shape product direction and drive continuous improvement.

This is a remote role, with close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Engineering in Palo Alto, CA, USA. The role includes moderate travel, primarily within continental Europe. Some infrequent intercontinental travel may be required for discussions and collaboration with the US team.

Responsibilities

  • Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of thermo-mechanical engineers, setting the technical direction, hiring, mentoring team members, and driving field execution across Europe.

  • Collaborate closely with the sales team to lead technical discussions, scope proof-of-concept (PoC) evaluations, and deliver compelling product demonstrations to prospective enterprise customers.

  • Guide customer engineering teams through the evaluation phase by overseeing simulation setup, running complex test cases, and interpreting results to explicitly prove Vinci’s technical and business value.

  • Own customer enablement through onboarding, deployment pipeline and account expansion, providing senior technical guidance, structured training sessions, and advanced troubleshooting.

  • Provide product guidance and feedback, identify customer pain points and workflow bottlenecks, partnering directly with internal product and engineering teams to transform field feedback into critical new product features.

  • Represent Vinci at major industry conferences and semiconductor events, engaging technically with key prospects and partners through technical presentations and live platform demonstrations.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of competitive technologies, industry trends, and market positioning to communicate Vinci’s differentiators effectively.

Qualifications (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Education: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field.

  • Technical depth: Expert-level mastery of commercial simulation software (Asys, Abaqus, or equivalent), with 15+ years of hands-on experience in thermo-mechanical simulations— either as a practitioner running simulations or as a technical account manager for commercial physics simulation software.

  • Industry Domain: Deep familiarity with semiconductor electronics packaging, advanced packaging technologies (e.g., 2.5D/3D IC), or foundry ecosystems.

  • Customer Engagement: Prior experience in dedicated customer-facing roles, with a strong ability to build trust and manage engineering client relationships.

  • Automation & Scripting: Practical programming experience using Python or C++ to automate workflows or parse simulation data.

  • Leadership Impact: Proven track record of prior managerial or technical leadership experience, with the ability to scale, mentor, and drive execution across engineering teams.

  • Communication: Elite interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex physics and simulation results into clear, high-impact narratives for both deep technical panels and business-oriented executives.

Preferred (Desirable Differentiators)

  • Multiphysics Breadth: Familiarity with thermal solutions management and/or Electrical Signal Integrity and Power Integrity (SI/PI) workflows.

  • Commercial Track Record: Direct experience commercializing technical software—ideally electronic design automation (EDA) or CAE simulation tools—into major semiconductor and electronics enterprises.

  • Go-To-Market Experience: Prior experience explicitly within technical pre-sales, application engineering (FAE), or strategic technical sales environments.

  • Emerging Tech Adjacency: Ability to rapidly adopt and champion next-generation, physics-based workflows and AI-assisted design or simulation tools.

Why Join Us

  • Not just use AI; be part of a team actively redefining how next-generation silicon and hardware are architected.

  • Work at the absolute convergence of state-of-the-art AI models, fundamental physics, and high-stakes enterprise

  • Collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers in a fast-moving startup environment.

Compensation: $110K – $140K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus
